    SnacksChilli cheese friesChips under beef chilli, cheddar and jalapeñosHow to make it1kg frozen chips400g beef mince1 onion2 tsp smoked paprika2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp chilli powder400g tin crushed tomatoes400g tin kidney beans150g cheddar100g sour cream1 jar pickled jalapeños2 spring onionsBake the frozen chips at 220°C for 25 minutes, turning once.Meanwhile brown the beef mince with the diced onion, add the smoked paprika, the ground cumin, the chilli powder, the crushed tomatoes and the drained kidney beans, and simmer 20 minutes until thick.Pile the chips into a baking dish, spoon over the chilli, scatter with the grated cheddar and grill 3 minutes until melted.Top with the sour cream, sliced jalapeños and spring onion.Soft pretzels with apple butterChewy salted twists with spiced apple butter and hot mustardHow to make it500g pizza dough60g bicarbonate of soda1 egg1 tsp sea salt flakes4 apples60g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon100ml apple juice1 jar American mustard2 L waterDivide the pizza dough into pieces, roll each into a 50cm rope and twist into pretzels.Bring the water and the bicarb to a simmer and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.Lay on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes until deep brown.For the apple butter, simmer the peeled diced apples with the brown sugar, the cinnamon and the apple juice for 25 minutes and mash smooth.Serve with American mustard.Hot PlatesAmish chicken and noodles over mashShredded chicken and thick egg noodles in peppery broth over buttery mashHow to make it800g chicken thigh fillets1.5 L chicken stock1 onion2 carrots2 celery sticks300g wide egg noodles1kg potatoes60g butter100ml full cream milk1 tsp white pepper1 bunch parsleySimmer the chicken thighs in the chicken stock with the diced onion, the diced carrots and the celery sticks for 35 minutes.Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.Add the wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens.Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper.Meanwhile boil the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with the butter and the milk.Ladle the chicken and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.Gravy train pot roastBeef chuck braised slowly with onions, carrots and potatoes, gravy from the potHow to make it1.4kg beef chuck roast2 tbsp vegetable oil2 onions, cut in wedges4 carrots, in chunks800g potatoes, in chunks2 tbsp tomato paste750ml beef stock3 sprigs of thyme1 tbsp cornflourSeason the beef and sear on all sides in the oil in a heavy pot.Add the onions and tomato paste, then the stock and thyme. Cover and cook at 160°C for 2 hours.Add the carrots and potatoes, cover again and cook for 1 hour more, until the beef falls apart.Lift out the beef and vegetables. Thicken the pot juices with the cornflour mixed with water and simmer into gravy.Pull the beef into chunks and serve with the vegetables and gravy.Sweets & DrinksShoofly molasses crumb pieStraight from Ishmael's Amish country. Sticky molasses pie, brown sugar crumbHow to make it1 sheet shortcrust pastry150g plain flour100g brown sugar60g butter150ml molasses1 egg1 tsp bicarbonate of soda200ml thickened cream180ml waterLine a 23cm pie dish with the shortcrust pastry sheet.Rub the plain flour, the brown sugar and the cold butter into crumbs.Whisk the molasses, the egg and the hot water with the bicarb.Pour into the pastry case, then scatter the crumbs evenly over the top.Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes, then drop to 180°C for 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble.Cool 30 minutes and serve with the whipped cream.DrinksVanilla malt milkshakeNot Big Ern's Tanqueray and Tab. Vanilla ice cream, milk and malt, blended thickHow to make it600ml full cream milk1 L vanilla ice cream5 tbsp malted milk powder1 tsp vanilla extract150ml thickened creamChill the tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes.Blend the cold full cream milk with the vanilla ice cream, the malted milk powder and the vanilla extract until thick and smooth.Pour into the cold glasses.Whip the thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and sprinkle each with a little more malt powder.Serve straight away with thick straws.
